name: Nitrazolam
summary: Hypnotic benzodiazepine that is the triazolo analogue of Nitrazepam and about 4x more potent compared to the parent compound. It is also  dechlorinated derivative of clonazolam with roughly 1/10 potency.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: A study in mice indicated that nitrazolam can be several times more potent than diazepam as an antagonist of electroshock-induced tonic-extensor convulsions but less potent than diazepam at preventing the righting reflex.

uses.text: Nitrazolam is a triazolobenzodiazepine (TBZD), which are benzodiazepine (BZD) derivatives, that has been sold online as a designer drug. A study in mice indicated that nitrazolam can be several times more potent than diazepam as an antagonist of electroshock-induced tonic-extensor convulsions but less potent than diazepam at preventing the righting reflex.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is more potent than nitrazepam, which makes accidental heavy sedation easier. Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory gaps. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause seizures, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它的藥效比硝西泮更強，因此更容易發生意外的深度鎮靜。苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與記憶斷片。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，大量使用後突然停藥可能引發癲癇發作，甚至有生命危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它的药效比硝西泮更强，因此更容易发生意外的深度镇静。苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与记忆断片。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，大量使用后突然停药可能引发癫痫发作，甚至有生命危险。

fact.en: It is clonazolam with the chlorine atom removed, and the triazolo version of nitrazepam. Adding that extra triazole ring is a common way chemists make a benzodiazepine more potent.
fact.zh: 它是去掉氯原子的克氯唑侖，也是硝西泮的三唑衍生物。加上這個額外的三唑環，是化學家讓苯二氮平藥效增強的常見手法。
fact.zhHans: 它是去掉氯原子的克氯唑仑，也是硝西泮的三唑衍生物。加上这个额外的三唑环，是化学家让苯二氮平药效增强的常见手法。
